relationship: Moving the circle construction changes its measured angles while the applicable circle-theorem relationship remains a constraint linking them.

learnerLoop.action: Move the construction and complete the linked angles and reasons.
learnerLoop.modelChange: The dynamic points and dependent angle measures update.
learnerLoop.evidence: The diagram, angle labels, answer checks and theorem reasons show whether the relationship holds.
learnerLoop.nextDecision: Choose the theorem and value needed for the next linked angle.

invariants: Dependent angles remain governed by the selected circle theorem as the construction moves.
Every calculation is justified by the required geometric conditions and applicable circle theorem.
safeAdaptations: Vary valid circle configurations and angle values while preserving each theorem relationship.
Adjust working requirements or feedback without replacing construction-based evidence.
nonGoals: Treating a visually plausible angle as proof without its circle-theorem reason.

task.description: Current problem statement and supplied quantities.
task.visibility: Shown at the start of each problem or stage.

model.description: Operated construction and its live measurements; see quantities for what is given and revealed.
model.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

working.description: Ordered calculations, learner entries and consequential evidence for the current task.
working.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

completion.description: Achievement, next task or learning transition.
completion.visibility: Shown only when the local completion conditions below are satisfied; representation controls are separately identified.

checkpoints.description: Existing objective markers expose current task and work phase on hover/focus.
checkpoints.visibility: Present for the current problem; child controls and readouts follow the states described below.

given-geometry.description: Problem-specific angle/length givens, labelled points, chord/tangent relationships and the requested x/length.
given-geometry.domain: Angles in degrees; lengths in cm when used.
given-geometry.source: Supplied in the goal and construction.
given-geometry.output: Live angle/length evidence updates during geometric repair.

structure-and-invariant.description: A repaired diameter/tangent/equal-chord condition and its invariance under the designated movement.
structure-and-invariant.domain: Constrained point/line angles and chord/tangent lengths.
structure-and-invariant.source: Learner moves the relevant handles; a later target tests invariance.
structure-and-invariant.output: geometryPhase() gates the theorem and calculation steps.

calculation-and-reasons.description: Requested numeric value, variant-specific intermediate lengths/angles and textual circle reasons. Step numbers are workflow labels; reason fields are explanations, not numeric quantities.
calculation-and-reasons.domain: Degrees, cm, numeric expressions and short reason text.
calculation-and-reasons.source: fieldDefinitions()/requiredKeys() select inputs according to objective and Working level.
calculation-and-reasons.output: Dependent fields unlock after prior correct values; checked results drive the same working cards.

modes.none: Construction and invariant stress-test remain required; theorem and calculation are revealed when the geometry justifies them.
modes.some: Key numeric result is required after the visual test; shown theorem/setup remain support.
modes.all: Relevant intermediate numeric results and circle reasons are required; field dependencies vary by objective.
modes.objectives: Right-angle structures, a chord angle network, paired tangents, then equal chords/centre distance; generated variants and later mixed practice retain the same local rules.

dependencies: Repair the structure before the stress-test/invariant phase.
Geometry readiness precedes required working; some numeric fields depend on an earlier correct result.
Each objective has three generated problems before progression; mixed practice follows the last objective.
implementation.completion: problemComplete() requires geometryReady() and all required fields/reasons validated. Objective checkpoints and the completion card describe the resulting progression.
limitations: Circle reason checking uses the existing phrase/keyword rules; this map does not claim assessment-quality natural-language marking.
